resources.string: These are declared hosting settings. Saving does not verify a region, resolve an account, or establish network isolation.
Optional literal text. Supplied empty text, whitespace and the word unknown stay distinct from omission. No region is selected automatically.
Optional opaque secret:// reference only. Do not enter an account password, token or credential. The reference is not resolved here.
Optional declared choice: public, private or air_gapped. No network setting is applied or verified.
Pending input is retained only within the private recovery limit and requires explicit review. Invalid account references are excluded from recovery. No pending input is a saved revision.
Enter valid text or remove the supplied field.
Use an opaque secret:// reference with only the permitted letters, numbers, slash, underscore, colon, period or hyphen; or remove the supplied field.
Choose public, private or air_gapped, or leave this field not supplied.
This field exceeds the local editor limit. Shorten it or remove the supplied field.
